prelaunch_updates.text: SCAM ALERT from @termix_ai (3:56 AM CT Wed 10/28): people impersonating the TermiX team are soliciting investments. TermiX is not running any community fundraising; treat any such request as a scam. TGE still undated.

OPEN CAMPAIGN still open: official airdrop terms say the claim window stays open 3 months from the announced start (claim opened Mon 10/26), so it closes around Mon 1/26/2027 (computed from the terms; no exact date announced). Claim only at airdrop.ritualfoundation.org; look-alike domains such as airdrop.ritualfoundation.xyz are not official.

@GenLayer (12:49 PM CT): 'Scammers don't wait for TGE.' ChainPatrol is now watching for fake accounts, look-alike domains and impersonators before launch. Still no GEN TGE date or contract; any GEN token trading now is fake.

OPEN CAMPAIGN (reopened Tue 10/27 9:07 AM CT): GEN airdrop registration is open again 'for a few more days'; no end date given, so treat it as closing any time. Register only at airdrop.genlayer.com (linked by @GenLayer); it never asks for a seed phrase. No GEN token exists yet: Aspecta pre-market prices are futures bets, not a token, and any GEN token trading on-chain now is fake.
GEN tokenomics paper published Tue 10/27 (staking, spending, issuance, governance). Still no TGE date or token contract, so any GEN token trading now is fake. Season 2 Points keep running to mainnet.
Native QTC now swappable on InstaSwap (BTC, ETH, SOL or stablecoins into QTC), routed through NEAR Intents. Adds a third DEX path on NEAR next to Rhea Finance.
KOL Posts TP rewards campaign paused (no reopen date); Kaito Katalyst campaign still open. New: BNB Chain Quant Agent live with 10x TP rewards, and Binance Agent ID integration.

Partner mainnet went live Mon 10/26 (invite-only via the Bread wallet; codes go out in waves to the early-access list, deposits capped under about $1,232; the network is temporary and will reset before public mainnet). No token yet. Polygon says Miden 'may' airdrop about 10% of supply to POL stakers (non-binding, undated).

OPEN CAMPAIGN (opened Mon 10/26, no end date given): RITUAL community airdrop claim. 50M RITUAL (0.5% of supply, fully unlocked) for eligible Infernet operators, Frenrug users and long-time community members; eligibility was set from past work, so nothing new can be earned. Check only at airdrop.ritualfoundation.org.

OPEN CAMPAIGN (launched Mon 10/26, no end date): Antseed Points. Paid AI usage through the network earns points; each weekly epoch's ANTS pool is claimable every Thursday (buyer cap 5% of pool). Free models and 0x providers earn nothing. ANTS is still non-transferable on Base, so there is no market; fake 'Ants' tokens trade on Solana, BSC, Arc and Robinhood chain. Only antseed.com and @AntSeed.
